meta_description: James Clive Decorating is a trusted painter and decorator in Leicester. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, local family business.
hero_subhead: From interior feature walls to complete exterior repaints, we transform your Leicester home with precision and care.
services_subhead: We handle everything from careful preparation and interior redecoration to exterior painting and specialist finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting and Decoration
services.desc: Full room redecorating including wallpaper removal, surface preparation, and choice of emulsion or specialist finishes. We protect your furniture and leave a clean workspace.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior repaints using quality exterior-grade paints. We inspect and repair any damaged woodwork before painting for a finish that lasts.

services.title: Woodwork and Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and window frames brought back to life. Undercoat and gloss applied for a durable, professional look.

services.title: Wallpapering and Wall Features
services.desc: Precision wallpaper hanging and feature walls that add character. We source quality papers and ensure seamless joins and a smooth finish.

services.title: Preparation and Repair
services.desc: We don't skip the fundamentals. Proper surface preparation—filling, sanding, and priming—ensures your new paint job lasts years, not months.

services.title: Commercial and Retail Spaces
services.desc: Office redecorating and shop refurbishment completed efficiently and on schedule. We work around your business hours to minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: Good decoration starts with honest prep work, not shortcuts.
about_para_1: James Clive Decorating was founded on a simple idea: homes and businesses deserve decorators who take time to do the job properly. Over two decades, we've built our reputation across Leicester by showing up on time, preparing surfaces thoroughly, and using quality materials. We treat every project—whether a single bedroom or a commercial space—with the same care and attention.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen to what you actually want, not what we think you should have. We're straightforward about costs, we clean up after ourselves, and we're not afraid to say if a wall needs more prep time to look its best. That's earned us steady work across Wigston, Oadby, and the wider Leicester area.

reviews.text: James came round, gave us a fair quote, and got on with the work without any fuss. Took three days to do our lounge and hallway, came in on budget, and left the place spotless. Really pleased with how it's turned out.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our kitchen was looking tired, so we asked James to give it a fresh coat and new wallpaper. The prep work he did was really thorough—he filled every crack and sanded everything down properly. Finish is immaculate. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of our house painted last summer. James organised everything, worked around the weather, and didn't leave until it was done right. He even pointed out some loose putty round a window frame before it became a bigger problem. That's the kind of tradesman you want.
reviews.author: Richard H.
